description.zh:
需要使用弹性伸缩服务的地域ID。

例如`cn-hangzhou`、`cn-shanghai`。更多信息，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the region where you want to use Auto Scaling.

Examples: `ap-southeast-1` and `ap-southeast-5`. For more information, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 验证是否已开通弹性伸缩服务
title.en: Verify whether Auto Scaling is activated
